projectFolder.name: One Time Mishnah Class - Rabbi Elie Scheller

subfolders.name: 00 Start Here - Proposal and Project Map
subfolders.purpose: Canonical proposal, project map, task map, and rules for what belongs in this project.

subfolders.name: 01 Agreement and Values
subfolders.purpose: Drafts and decisions for values, partnership terms, responsibilities, buyout, dispute resolution, and formal agreement language.

subfolders.name: 02 Offer, Pricing, and Policies
subfolders.purpose: Library tier, Live Membership, later Premium Cohort, refund/cancellation policy, family/device rules, and launch offer decisions.

subfolders.name: 03 GHL and Community Setup
subfolders.purpose: GHL location, contacts, tags, pipelines, workflows, payments, access control, reporting, and smoke-test notes.

subfolders.name: 04 Content and Media Intake
subfolders.purpose: Rabbi video drops, worksheets, source sheets, recordings, organic clips, ad candidates, and publishing handoff notes.

subfolders.name: 05 Marketing and Launch
subfolders.purpose: Landing pages, email list launch, old customer reactivation, ads, testimonials, tracking, and launch copy.

subfolders.name: 06 Bot and Agent Loop
subfolders.purpose: Rabbi Telegram bot, scoped task collaboration, Codex GHL workflow cards, browser/API boundaries, and status reports.

subfolders.name: 07 Finance, Reporting, and Admin
subfolders.purpose: Billing, expenses, monthly split reports, refunds, failed payments, bookkeeping, and approved hard expense records.

subfolders.name: 08 Shiur and Source Materials
subfolders.purpose: Mishnayos class prep, source sheets, worksheets, question digests, and Torah product planning.

subfolders.name: 09 Claude Drafting Tasks
subfolders.purpose: Draft-only work for Claude or another writing assistant: proposal cleanup, copy variants, policies, prompts, and summaries.

subfolders.name: 90 Completed and Approved
subfolders.purpose: Final approved documents, launch assets, exported reports, and completed workflow evidence.

subfolders.name: 99 Needs Shloimie Decision
subfolders.purpose: Blocked items that need a human partnership, offer, legal, budget, or access decision.

contentMediaIntakeFolders.name: 04.00 Upload Here - Videos and Audio for Transcription
contentMediaIntakeFolders.actualName: 04.00 Upload Here - Videos and Audio for Transcription
contentMediaIntakeFolders.purpose: Rabbi class videos, shiur audio, meeting recordings, and any media that should become transcript, parse, or content candidates.
contentMediaIntakeFolders.handling: automation/transcription intake; can create content jobs; still no publish/send without approval.

contentMediaIntakeFolders.name: 04.05 Upload Here - Slideshows and Source Materials
contentMediaIntakeFolders.actualName: 04.05 Upload Here - Slideshows and Source Materials
contentMediaIntakeFolders.purpose: PowerPoints, Google Slides, PDFs, worksheets, source sheets, handouts, and classroom materials that do not need transcription.
contentMediaIntakeFolders.handling: source_material / slideshow_reference; no transcription; index only until reviewed.

contentMediaIntakeFolders.name: 04.10 Ingestion Queue - Transcribe and Parse
contentMediaIntakeFolders.purpose: Files/jobs actively being processed into transcripts, source notes, clip plans, and content jobs.
contentMediaIntakeFolders.handling: internal workflow queue; not the main Rabbi-facing drop-off folder unless intentionally used.
contentMediaIntakeFolders.backendUse: bna_content_jobs.status=ingested|parsed with Drive file/folder IDs preserved

contentMediaIntakeFolders.name: 04.20 Source Material Review
contentMediaIntakeFolders.purpose: Reviewed or queued slide/source-material references, source sheets, and worksheet review.
contentMediaIntakeFolders.handling: review lane only; no automatic public/member output.
contentMediaIntakeFolders.backendUse: bna_content_outputs output_type=source_material_review before member-visible or newsletter use

contentMediaIntakeFolders.name: 04.30 Social and Newsletter Output Drafts - Platform Review
contentMediaIntakeFolders.purpose: Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram, WhatsApp, newsletter, and email drafts awaiting platform review.
contentMediaIntakeFolders.handling: no sends or publishes without explicit approval.
contentMediaIntakeFolders.backendUse: bna_content_outputs output_type/platform metadata before any Buffer or platform write

contentMediaIntakeFolders.name: 04.90 Approved and Posted Outputs
contentMediaIntakeFolders.purpose: Approved exports, destination URLs, screenshots, posted/published evidence, metrics, and rollback notes.
contentMediaIntakeFolders.backendUse: Buffer/social destination evidence and Workflow Q/R reporting after approval

contentMediaIntakeFolders.name: 04.99 Needs Shloimie Decision
contentMediaIntakeFolders.purpose: Ambiguous files, wrong-lane uploads, permissions/conflict issues, and files needing operator routing.
contentMediaIntakeFolders.backendUse: operator decision queue; do not transcribe, publish, send, or create member-visible output

watched_lanes.title: 04.00 Upload Here - Videos and Audio for Transcription
watched_lanes.email_behavior: Send an operator email with Drive view and direct download link for new media files.
watched_lanes.handling: Transcription intake candidate only; no publish/send/student/member action is automatic.

watched_lanes.title: 04.05 Upload Here - Slideshows and Source Materials
watched_lanes.email_behavior: Send an operator email with Drive view and direct download link for new original files such as .pptx.
watched_lanes.handling: Source-material only; PowerPoint/Slides/PDF/source sheets do not trigger transcription.

dropoffNotificationWorkflow.direct_download_policy: Prefer original non-native Drive files such as .pptx, .mp4, .mov, .m4a, and .pdf. Suppress native Google Slides conversion emails when a same-title original downloadable file exists.
no_automatic_actions: no publish/send beyond the operator notification email
